newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Uniwide long-term buy - BPI.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Uniwide long-term buy - BPI.

text.p: BPI Securities Corp recommended on Tuesday a long-term buy on retailer Uniwide Holdings Inc saying it is expected to post higher-than-expected profits in 1996.

The BPI report said Uniwide is set to post net profits of 760 million pesos for 1996, higher than the 731 million-peso target announced during its initial public offering last year. It was listed on the stock exchange on August 19.
